nodes.label: main() / MagickMain()
nodes.desc: Entry point of the magick binary; forwards to MagickCommandGenesis.

nodes.label: MagickCommandGenesis()
nodes.desc: Sets up the MagickCLI environment and drives option processing.

nodes.label: ProcessCommandOptions()
nodes.desc: Reads argv tokens sequentially; options execute in the order typed.

nodes.label: CLIOption()
nodes.desc: Central dispatcher sorting each option into setting, no-image, simple, or list class.

nodes.label: "read" option
nodes.desc: A filename argument triggers ReadImages() into the current image list.

nodes.label: "write" option
nodes.desc: Output filename triggers WriteImages() with a cloned ImageInfo.

nodes.label: "-resize" dispatch
nodes.desc: LocaleCompare on the option name, ParseRegionGeometry, then ResizeImage().

nodes.label: struct _ImageInfo
nodes.desc: Global settings shared by every image in a run: compression, orientation, quality.

nodes.label: struct _Image
nodes.desc: One image: columns, rows, colorspace, and a pointer to its pixel cache.

nodes.label: AcquireImage()
nodes.desc: Allocates an Image seeded from ImageInfo defaults and attaches a pixel cache.

nodes.label: CloneImage()
nodes.desc: Duplicates an Image; operators work on copies so a chain of options never mutates the source.

nodes.label: SyncImageSettings()
nodes.desc: Copies ImageInfo-level options (quality, density, depth) onto each Image.

nodes.label: GetMagickInfo()
nodes.desc: Looks up a format's MagickInfo: handlers, thread support, module name.

nodes.label: GetImageDecoder()
nodes.desc: Returns the registered DecodeImageHandler for the format.

nodes.label: GetImageEncoder()
nodes.desc: Returns the registered EncodeImageHandler for the format.

nodes.label: ReadImage()
nodes.desc: SetImageInfo resolves the format, then decoder() runs; delegate fallback if none.

nodes.label: decoder() call
nodes.desc: Policy-checked invocation of the coder's read handler.

nodes.label: WriteImage()
nodes.desc: Mirrors ReadImage on output: registry lookup, encoder call, policy check.

nodes.label: encoder() call
nodes.desc: The coder's write handler pulls pixels from the cache and serializes them.

nodes.label: GetDelegateInfo()
nodes.desc: Consults delegates.xml for an external program covering the format.

nodes.label: InvokeDelegate()
nodes.desc: Expands format strings into a shell command for the external program.

nodes.label: ExternalDelegateCommand()
nodes.desc: Actually executes the external process and waits for it.

nodes.label: AcquirePixelCache()
nodes.desc: Creates the CacheInfo structure backing an image's pixels.

nodes.label: GetImagePixelCache()
nodes.desc: The accessor every operator uses to reach pixels; opens or clones cache as needed.

nodes.label: OpenPixelCache()
nodes.desc: Resource-accounted allocation: tries RAM first, then file map, then plain disk.

nodes.label: MemoryCache
nodes.desc: Anonymous memory or heap block; the fast path for images that fit.

nodes.label: MapCache
nodes.desc: File-backed mmap of the on-disk cache when map resources allow.

nodes.label: DiskCache
nodes.desc: Seek-and-read cache on a temp file; why huge images stop needing RAM.

nodes.label: AcquireMagickResource()
nodes.desc: Area, memory, map, and disk budgets decide which cache type wins.

nodes.label: ResizeImage()
nodes.desc: Acquires a resize filter, then runs the two separable passes.

nodes.label: HorizontalFilter()
nodes.desc: First pass: resample each row with the filter's contribution weights.

nodes.label: VerticalFilter()
nodes.desc: Second pass: resample the intermediate result column-wise.

nodes.label: ReadPNGImage()
nodes.desc: PNG coder's decoder; writes decoded scanlines into the pixel cache.

nodes.label: ReadJPEGImage()
nodes.desc: JPEG coder's decoder wrapping libjpeg; also provides WriteJPEGImage().
